rows.Origin:
Bred by Hans Jürgen Evers (1940-2007) (Germany, 2004).
Introduced in Germany by Rosen-Tantau/Tantau Roses in 2009 as 'Johann Wolfgang von Goethe Rose'.
rows.Bloom: Dark red, ages to carmine-pink . Strong, anise, honey, sweet fragrance. up to 100 petals. Average diameter 5.5". Very large, very full (41+ petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Bushy. Medium green foliage.

Height: 39" to 47" (100 to 120cm).
